newsitem.title: USA: State Farm auto units post improved 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: State Farm auto units post improved 1996 results.

text.p: State Farm Insurance Cos said on Tuesday its auto insurers State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Co and State Farm Indemnity Co had 1996 earned premiums of $25.5 billion, up 2.7 percent over 1995.
With an underwriting gain of $651 million and a net investment gain of $2.7 billion, net income from all sources after federal income taxes was $2.4 billion.
In 1995 earned premiums were $24.8 billion, underwriting loss $1.2 billion, net investment gain $2.4 billion, and net income after federal income tax $1.0 billion.

Assets of State Farm Mutual grew to $60.9 billion from $54.8 billion, while assets of State Farm Indemnity grew to $1.3 billion from $1.1 billion. Incurred claim losses and loss expenses were $20.2 billion versus $21.5 billion in 1995.

State Farm Mutual's property insurance affiliates, State Farm Fire and Casualty Co, State Farm General Insurance Co, State Farm Lloyds and State Farm County Mutual Insurance Co of Texas, reported an underwriting loss of $1.2 billion on earned premiums of $8.5 billion.
The results, combined with a net investment gain of $903.9 million, resulted in a net loss of $68.2 million compared with net income of $90.0 million in 1995, the company said.
